deadline.value: Apply by 31 January 2027 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline31 January 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to this field.

supervisor.value: Name faculty of interest in the application; no prior commitment is needed, but contacting faculty is encouraged.
supervisor.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years (from September 2026).
funding.quote: All full-time students in UBC-Vancouver PhD programs will be provided with a funding package of at least $40,000 for each of the first four years of their PhD from September 2026.

entry_route.value: Normally admitted after a master's; exceptional applicants can enter straight from a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Applicants admitted to the Ph.D. degree program normally possess a master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related area, with clear evidence of research ability or potential. | Exceptional applicants may be admitted directly to the Ph.D. program from the bachelor's level

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional. The UBC Calendar lists it as not mandatory but strongly recommended.
gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is optional.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 93 overall (old 120-point scale) or 4.5 on the new 6-point scale; section minimums apply.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 93

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 6.5
